chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Abī al-Miʿzā, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, who said:

I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a pregnant woman who sees blood for a day or two. He said: “If it is fresh blood, then she should not perform salat during those two days; but if it is yellowish discharge, then she should perform ghusl at the time of every two salats.”

key_terms.عِنْدَ كُلِّ صَلَاتَيْنِ: at the time of every two salats

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a pregnant woman who sees blood for one or two days?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a pregnant woman who sees blood briefly. It distinguishes between fresh blood and yellowish discharge, assigning different rulings for salat and ghusl based on the nature of what is seen.
